EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Debug Hypotheses

Debug Hypotheses workflow for coding agents. Use when a failure has multiple plausible explanations.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Rank hypotheses by supplied evidence; attach a discriminating check to each.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: A request returns 401 with no other evidence.

Check request headers and token validity before asserting a cause.

Use the helper

rank_hypotheses

Source: skills/debug-hypotheses/SKILL.md in the package. Use this workflow selectively; it does not override user or system instructions.
